2608.24386.title: Equivariant Covariance Tensors: Guaranteed SPD Uncertainty for Tensor-Valued Geometric Learning
2608.24386.paper_summary: Tensor-valued prediction is fundamental to geometric deep learning, yet uncertainty quantification (UQ) for such outputs remains an open challenge. While E(3)-equivariant neural networks excel at point estimates, they lack rigorous confidence measures. We focus on symmetric rank-2 tensor prediction, where the target has six Kelvin--Mandel coordinates and full uncertainty is represented by a $6\times6$ covariance matrix. We introduce a framework for E(3)-equivariant UQ, modeling the full predictive distribution where both mean and covariance preserve rotational symmetry. Our approach decomposes the covariance into irreducible representations $\mathrm{Sym}^2(ρ_c) \cong 2\times(l=0) \oplus 2\times(l=2) \oplus 1\times(l=4)$. By mapping from the flat Lie algebra $\mathfrak{sym}(6)$ to the curved SPD manifold via matrix exponentiation, we strictly ensure positive-definite covariances while maintaining exact equivariance. Furthermore, we formulate a Log-Euclidean Equivariant Scoring Objective (LE-ESO)---a robust surrogate loss based on the Multivariate Laplace distribution---providing robustness to heavy-tailed errors and stable optimization. Validation on ModelNet40 inertia tensors and Materials Project dielectric tensors demonstrates that our method achieves competitive performance and provides physically consistent, symmetry-preserving uncertainty estimates with useful risk and OOD sensitivity.
2608.24386.paper_summary_zh: 張量值預測是幾何深度學習的基礎，但對於這類輸出的不確定性量化（UQ）仍然是一個未解的挑戰。雖然E(3)-等變神經網絡在點估計方面表現出色，但它們缺乏嚴謹的置信度測量。我們專注於對稱的二階張量預測，其中目標具有六個Kelvin--Mandel坐標，且完整的不確定性由一個$6\times6$的協方差矩陣表示。我們引入了一個E(3)-等變UQ的框架，建模完整的預測分佈，其中均值和協方差都保持旋轉對稱性。我們的方法將協方差分解為不可約表示$\mathrm{Sym}^2(ρ_c) \cong 2\times(l=0) \oplus 2\times(l=2) \oplus 1\times(l=4)$。通過將平坦的李代數$\mathfrak{sym}(6)$映射到曲率的SPD流形，並通過矩陣指數化，我們嚴格確保正定的協方差，同時保持精確的等變性。此外，我們制定了一個對數歐幾里得等變評分目標（LE-ESO）——基於多變量拉普拉斯分佈的穩健替代損失——提供對重尾誤差的穩健性和穩定的優化。在ModelNet40慣性張量和Materials Project介電張量上的驗證顯示，我們的方法實現了具有競爭力的性能，並提供物理一致的、保持對稱性的不確定性估計，具有有用的風險和OOD敏感性。
